articles.title: Erika Kirk blasts ‘beyond disgusting’ jokes after Dave Chappelle mocks Charlie Kirk’s assassination
articles.summary: “Ever since that guy Charlie Kirk got murdered, and I shouldn’t say this publicly, but I feel better,” Chappelle told fans at Madison Square Garden on Saturday night.

articles.title: Biden reveals letter Trump left him at White House that made it seem 'as if there were two Donald Trumps'

articles.title: US evacuates 13 military aircraft from second UK base as new Iran threat raises alarm
